audit_items.proof_trace: Property holds by design: blobs from local EL skip KZG verification (L2185 `if !origin.is_from_el()`), but `compute_cells` (eip_7594.rs:L211-249) always invokes the underlying KZG library's `compute_cells_raw`, which performs the blob-to-cells transformation deterministically. Valid blobs produce valid columns by the EIP-7594 spec; invalid blobs produce deterministic but spec-invalid output that will be rejected when verified by peers or during reconstruction.
